request: Owner, /portal screenshot: «Ещё вот здесь анимация такая, лагучая. Нужно её исправить… по тому же принципу, чтобы всё ровненько, стык был ровный».

diagnosis.seam: At the loop point Vespi jumped forward: the last→first step was 2.20/255 (mean abs diff, 480 px grey) against 0.6–0.9 for neighbouring steps. About six frames of the ride were missing — cut on 7 Nov with the braking stop.
diagnosis.frame0_ghost: Frame 0 — and the poster landscapes/tuscany-*.webp, which is frame 0 — showed Vespi doubled (helmet and face blended from two positions), a leftover of easing the last frames into the first.
diagnosis.light: Steady: background luminance moves under 0.1/255 across the loop.
diagnosis.wrap: Even with a smooth ride, Chrome drops one frame when a looping video restarts (67–83 ms gap measured on the canvas), and the first frame of a compressed loop is coded afresh while the last is predicted from its neighbours, so the picture shimmers at the restart. Both are visible while Vespi moves.

fix: Decoded the shipped 2400 loop in YUV (no RGB round trip, so the BT.709 colour is unchanged).
Dropped the ghosted frame 0; the ride starts on the clean frame 1.
Six motion-compensated frames (ffmpeg minterpolate, mci/aobmc/bidir) bridge the old last frame and frame 1: step 0.54 against 0.58–0.93 around it.
Rotated the loop so it restarts on the empty road (old frames 223/224, step 0.014): the dropped frame and the shimmer fall where nothing moves.
One keyframe only, at the restart (x264 keyint 400, scenecut 0; VP9 g 400): a forced keyframe mid-ride made its own pop (1.1–1.9).
Exact 30 fps, 356 frames, 11.867 s; two-pass at the old bitrates (2400 3.7 Mbit/s, 1600 1.78, 960 0.49; VP9 960 0.49); BT.709 primaries and matrix, sRGB transfer, faststart.

The poster is frame 133 of the new loop (Vespi on the road), decoded with the BT.709 matrix; still areas match the old poster within 0.33/255. LivingLandscape takes startAt={133.5/30}: it seeks there before the canvas appears, so the handover from poster to canvas stays invisible.

measured.restart_step_mp4: 0.39 (2400) – 0.88 (960) on a still frame, was 2.20 with Vespi moving
measured.largest_step: 1.5–1.6, Vespi accelerating out of the distance (content, as before)
